contea di ritrovamento: Rutland (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy radiate of Carausius (286-93), probably a contemporary copy struck over an earlier coin, possibly of Claudius II (268-70). The obverse is clearly Carausius. The reverse shows Providentia standing left with baton over globe and cornucopiae with the legend [ ](AV?)S.
